ns2:course.label: Stereotypes, Prejudice & Discrimination
ns2:course.description: Course in Inequality & Cultural Understanding provides an interdisciplinary introduction to questions related to societal inequality. Each section emphasizes experiential learning through, for example, field trips or hands-on, community-based research projects. Prerequisite: This course is intended for first and second year students.
